record.title: Cybersecurity Standard Practice Guide — Security Guide for the Development of Agentic AI Systems (Draft for Comment)
record.original_title: 网络安全标准实践指南——智能体系统开发安全指南（征求意见稿）
record.short_title: TC260 draft guide on agentic AI system development security
record.issuing_body: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) Secretariat
record.summary: Draft TC260 practice guide on the secure development of agentic AI systems built on large models, covering the preparation, design, implementation, testing and release stages. It names risks such as prompt injection, goal deviation, privilege abuse, memory poisoning and cascading failure, and sets principles of risk orientation, graded control, human controllability and defence in depth. Measures include a risk register, models meeting GB/T 45654-2025, execution limits, rollback for irreversible operations, human confirmation, review and takeover of high-risk operations, guardrails, supply-chain checks, sandboxing, red-team testing and a pre-release security assessment.
record.notes: Released for public comment by the TC260 Secretariat with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕119号 of 18 Sept 2026; comments were due by 2 Oct 2026. The draft is version v1.0-202609 and carries the number TC260-PG-2026NA. It covers software agentic AI systems built on large models, not agentic systems whose main function is controlling physical devices such as robots or autonomous vehicles. Its bibliography lists AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (CN-13) and TC260's practice guide on the security of deploying and using agents.

verification.note: Stored: the TC260 notice of 18 Sept 2026 (HTML) and the draft PDF attached to it (31 pages). Title, issuer, date, notice number, comment deadline and contents are confirmed from these; the summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found. That no final version had appeared by 14 Oct 2026 rests on the TC260 notice list as stored on that day for another candidate of this run, not on a file of this candidate.

judgment.status_reasoning: The notice of 18 Sept 2026 released the text as a draft for comment (征求意见稿), with comments due by 2 Oct 2026. The deadline has passed (today is 14 Oct 2026), but no final version is stored, and the TC260 notice list of 14 Oct 2026 (stored for C001) shows no release notice after this one other than an unrelated standards plan of 13 Oct. The text therefore stays a draft: Draft / proposed with legal_force Proposed, as for other draft guidelines in the register (EU-14, KR-05). Practice guides are non-binding technical documents in any case.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A draft TC260 guidance document on the security of developing AI agent systems: a government safety and risk-management guideline (AGENTS.md section 10, in with no note); drafts are kept as pending instruments.
judgment.identifier_reasoning: The cover number TC260-PG-2026NA has no serial number (NA), unlike final guides such as TC260-PG-20266A, so it is not used as the citable identifier; it and the notice number are given in the notes.
judgment.instrument_type_reasoning: TC260 practice guides are 'standard-related technical documents' giving practical guidance, not national standards; recorded as Guidelines / framework, as for TC260's AI Safety Governance Framework records.

open_questions: When TC260 publishes the final guide, this record needs a refresh (new number, date and status Published (non-binding, current)); the comment period closed on 2 Oct 2026.
